headline: Last session: Indian markets closed higher on Friday as IT stocks led gains; Nifty approached 23,000 mark

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Strong buying in IT stocks led the market higher in the last session
Positive brokerage sentiment and target price hikes for public and private sector banks
Anticipation surrounding the upcoming Reliance Jio IPO and Q2 corporate results
Strengthening rupee and positive global cues from US markets in previous sessions
whatHappening: Sensex rallied over 1,500 points recently to reach new milestones
Brokerages have issued bullish outlooks for PNB, Federal Bank, and Crompton Greaves
JLR India is expanding its retail presence in the National Capital Region
FCNR(B) deposit inflows are reportedly impacting the margins of private sector banks
summary: Indian markets concluded the last trading session with significant gains, driven by a rally in IT stocks and positive sentiment in the banking sector. Investors are currently monitoring Q2 results and the upcoming Reliance Jio IPO as key market drivers for the new week. While the market remains closed for the weekend, analysts maintain a bullish outlook on several large-cap stocks including HAL and Mphasis.
